scripts.script:

	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!

local Spin = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Spin")
local args = {"9378228", 1}

while true do
    Spin:FireServer(unpack(args))
    task.wait(0.1)
end
